Here is a detailed description of the illustrative figure, based on the provided methodology and caption.

### Figure Description

**1. Overall Layout**
The figure is a full-width academic pipeline diagram presented on a pure white background. The overall flow is linear, moving from left to right, and consists of six primary elements. The visual style is clean, modern, and professional, using a harmonious, muted color palette and serif fonts throughout.

**2. Components and Connections**

**Element 1: Input Box (Leftmost)**
*   **Shape and Style:** A rounded rectangle with a very light, almost off-white gray background fill, a light gray border, and a subtle drop shadow.
*   **Content:**
    *   At the top, the bold serif title "Input".
    *   Below the title, two lines of content:
        *   A code icon (`</>`) next to the text "Source Code".
        *   A checkbox icon next to the text "Test Case".

A thin, medium-dark gray arrow points from the Input box to the Python Tracer.

**Element 2: Python Tracer**
*   **Shape and Style:** A rounded rectangle with a very pale, soft blue background and a slightly darker soft blue border.
*   **Content:**
    *   A small gear icon is centered at the top.
    *   Below the icon, the bold serif title "Python Tracer".
    *   Beneath the title, the smaller, italicized gray text "sys.settrace".

A thin, medium-dark gray arrow points from the Python Tracer to the Raw Trace document.

**Element 3: Raw Trace**
*   **Shape and Style:** A single document icon with a folded top-right corner. It has a creamy, pale yellow background and contains four wavy horizontal lines to suggest text content.
*   **Labels:**
    *   The bold serif label "Raw Trace" is positioned **only above** the document icon.
    *   The smaller gray text "~2,000 tokens" is positioned **only below** the document icon.

**Element 4: Condition Cards (Central Group)**
This section consists of four distinct rectangular cards stacked vertically with a small gap between each. They represent different levels of information extracted from the trace.

*   **Connections to Cards:**
    *   Three colored, curved arrows fan out from the "Raw Trace" document, pointing to the top three cards (Exception Only, VOTA, Full Trace).
    *   A separate, **dashed gray arrow** originates from the initial "Input" box and points directly to the bottom card (No Trace), bypassing the tracer and trace steps.

*   **Card A: Exception Only (Top Card)**
    *   **Style:** This is the "hero" card, emphasized with a wider format, a stronger drop shadow, and a prominent gold border. The background is a very light, creamy yellow.
    *   **Content:**
        *   The bold serif title "Exception Only" is placed next to a small gold star icon.
        *   A small, gray subtitle reads: "type + stacktrace + message".
        *   A pill-shaped badge with a gold background and white text displays "99.83%".

*   **Card B: VOTA**
    *   **Style:** A standard-width card with a dark green accent bar on the left edge. The background is a pale mint green.
    *   **Content:**
        *   The bold serif title "VOTA".
        *   A small, gray subtitle reads: "exceptions + assertions + loops".
        *   A pill-shaped badge with a green background displays "99.05%".

*   **Card C: Full Trace**
    *   **Style:** A standard-width card with a warm brown accent bar on the left edge. The background is a pale peach color.
    *   **Content:**
        *   The bold serif title "Full Trace".
        *   A small, gray subtitle reads: "complete line-by-line trace".
        *   A pill-shaped badge with a brown background displays "81.44%".

*   **Card D: No Trace (Bottom Card)**
    *   **Style:** A muted, baseline card with a medium gray dashed border. The background is a light gray.
    *   **Content:**
        *   The bold serif title "No Trace".
        *   A small, gray subtitle reads: "source code only".
        *   A pill-shaped badge with a gray background displays "75.13%".

Four colored arrows, corresponding to the accent color of each card (gold, green, brown, gray), emerge from the right side of the cards and converge into the SFT Model.

**Element 5: SFT Model**
*   **Shape and Style:** A large rounded rectangle with a solid, deep, muted purple background.
*   **Content (all in white/light text):**
    *   The large, bold, white title "SFT".
    *   Below the title, the text "LoRA fine-tuning" in a lighter lavender color.
    *   At the bottom, the text "1.5B - 13B" in a similar light lavender color.

A single, solid dark arrow points from the SFT Model to the Verdict.

**Element 6: Verdict (Rightmost)**
*   **Shape and Style:** A single rectangle horizontally split into two halves.
*   **Content:**
    *   **Top Half:** A pale green background with a green checkmark icon and the text "Pass".
    *   **Bottom Half:** A pale red background with a red 'X' icon and the text "Fail".

**3. Annotations**
*   **Location:** Positioned at the bottom of the figure, spanning horizontally underneath the four condition cards.
*   **Content:**
    *   On the left, aligned with the cards: "← Information density decreases" in small, italic gray text.
    *   On the right, aligned with the cards: "Accuracy increases →" in small, italic gray text.
